title: Unicorn wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='horn' x1='0' y1='1' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd54a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffe98a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff6c9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='mane' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5fa2'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#b06cff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fd8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- mane behind the head -->
  <path d='M40 24 C26 26 20 40 24 54 C16 56 16 68 26 72 C18 78 22 90 34 90 L46 86 L44 30 Z' fill='url(#mane)'/>

  <path d='M55 22 L58 10 L66 20 Z' fill='#ffe6f2'/>

  <path d='M50 24 L54 4 L58 24 Z' fill='url(#horn)'/>
  <path d='M52 20 L54 8 M51 16 L56 14 M52 12 L57 11' stroke='#ffb020' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M36 30 C36 20 46 18 52 18 C64 18 72 26 72 38 C72 54 62 64 50 66 C38 66 36 50 36 30 Z' fill='#fff4fa'/>
  <path d='M40 56 C44 62 54 64 60 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0e4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <path d='M58 46 C66 44 76 46 80 54 C82 60 78 66 70 66 C62 66 56 60 56 54 Z' fill='#ffd9ec'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='54' rx='2.2' ry='3' fill='#e07aa8'/>
  <path d='M66 63 Q70 65 74 63' fill='none' stroke='#d95f96' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- mouth smile -->

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <path d='M38 36 L72 34 L73 46 L40 48 Z' fill='#20123a'/>

    <path d='M41 38 L40 46 L50 45 L51 37 Z'/>

  </g>
  <path d='M39 37 L40 46' stroke='#8a6bd6' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <path d='M71 36 L72 45' stroke='#8a6bd6' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <path d='M39 36 L72 34' stroke='#8a6bd6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 40 L33 38 M72 39 L76 37' stroke='#20123a' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheek sparkle -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='54' r='1.6' fill='#ff8fc2'/>
  <circle cx='49.5' cy='51' r='1' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
